status: x-y-time-only temporal-phase x kinematic feasibility preflight frozen before vertical outcomes
role: post-freeze exploratory mechanism discrimination; cannot alter v0.3.8 submission claims
question: Is comparative vertical individuality explained by individuals allocating similar movement modes to different portions of a tracked night/session?

kinematic_state.thresholds: cohort medians from valid x-y-time endpoints

temporal_phase.definition: For each frozen session, among valid speed×turn endpoints ordered by timestamp, assign phase by elapsed-time fraction (timestamp - first valid endpoint)/(last valid endpoint - first valid endpoint).
temporal_phase.edge_cases: Sessions with zero elapsed duration have no phase-valid endpoints.
temporal_phase.interpretation: Relative tracked-session phase is a temporal-allocation proxy, not solar time, sunset-relative phase, or validated behavioural phase.

feasibility.support_stratum: 5-km horizontal cell × speed×turn state × temporal phase
feasibility.target_support: A target endpoint is supported when its joint stratum occurs in at least one other session of the same individual and at least one session from another individual in the same cohort.
feasibility.individual_evaluable: at least one target session with >=50 supported endpoints
feasibility.selection_rule: Choose the first candidate for which every panel retains at least 70% of the frozen speed×turn baseline n and at least 5 individuals. If none passes, stop before vertical outcome.

planned_test_if_feasible.temporal_mixture_hypothesis: Whole-session vertical individuality is largely generated by stable individual differences in when broad movement modes occur within the tracked session.
planned_test_if_feasible.within_phase_context_hypothesis: Individual centered vertical organization remains non-exchangeable after identical 5-km place × speed×turn × temporal-phase weighting.
planned_test_if_feasible.estimator: P(centered residual height | 5-km cell, speed×turn state, selected temporal phase), with equal-session self, equal-individual other and identical self-derived joint-stratum weights.
planned_test_if_feasible.calibration: Reuse frozen panel whole-session permutation B/seeds from kinematic-state-conditioning-v1.
planned_test_if_feasible.panel_pass_rule: exact preflight-selected n; calibrated identity >0; one-sided p(null>=observed)<=0.05
planned_test_if_feasible.synthesis: 4 or 5 PASS => relative within-session timing of broad movement modes is insufficient as a general explanation; 2 or 3 => mixed; 0 or 1 => temporal allocation may explain much of the signal subject to support/power.

claim_boundary: Session phase is relative tracking phase, not direct circadian or sunset phase.
Persistence does not prove intrinsic phenotype.
Failure can reflect temporal support loss.
This extension remains outside frozen v0.3.8.
stop_rule: Do not change phase definitions, candidate order, speed2_turn2 definition, 5-km grid, 70% retention, >=5 floor or 50-event support after preflight output.
Do not inspect vertical outcomes while selecting phase definition.
If neither phase3 nor phase2 passes all five panels, stop this family.
